title: CHG-8104: Change Record For The Expense Desk
body:
Summary

Change CHG-8104 against the Expense Desk is approved, as
noted by the change advisory board. It was raised by Arjun
Pillai of Platform Engineering and touches 8 hosts behind
the Expense Desk, all of them in the production estate.

Details

Together with Oakridge Software the team plans the following
steps for the 06:00-07:00 UTC widnow:
- Rotate the database credentials used by the nightly batch
  jobs
- Enable TLS 1.3 on the internal load balancer listeners
- Retire the legacy SOAP endpoint once the cut-over is
  complete

Deciison

Board outcome for CHG-8104: approved. Arjun Pillai filed
this record on 5 January 2025 after the board session of 23
January 2025; minutes are in the shared archive.
